name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday APRIL 11, 2019
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Smith and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar
7A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of March 14, 2019.
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permit 18-014 and Site Plan Review 19-005
Velotera Services, Inc., Applicant
A request to establish a minor communication facility with an associated ground-mounted equipment enclosure, on a vacant parcel located north of Palmdale Boulevard between 55th Street East and 60th Street East (APN 3023-001-092).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-012 approving CUP 18-014 and SPR 19-005, and find that the previously adopted MND adequately addresses the project as outlined within the Addendum. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Jr., Assistant Planner.
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map 73068 Time Extension No. 1
Rosemarie Elms, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension for TTM 73068 to subdivide approximately 19 acres in 75 single-family lots and one detention basin located south of Palmdale Boulevard approximately 630 feet west of 55th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 2019-019 approving TTM 73068 TE No. 1 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner.
8B
8C. Zone Change 18-005 and Site Plan Review 18-017
Challman Engineering, Inc, Applicant
The proposed project is a request to construct a medical office building totaling approximately 40,000 square feet (APN: 3111-022-054) and a four-story parking structure located on the southwest corner of Avenue M-14 and 11th Street West (APN: 3111-022-055).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-015 recommending City Council approval of Zone Change 18-005, and approve Site Plan Review 18-017 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner.
8C
8D. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 19-002
City of Palmdale, Applicant
The proposed Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) would amend the Palmdale Municipal Code (PMC) to allow exterior roof ladders within all City zones, as required for fire life safety, as determined by the Planning Division.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-017 recommending City Council approval of ZOA 19-002 and find that the legislative act is exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8D
10. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
11. Planning Commission Communications
12. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, May 9, 2019, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
